pages.text: Every integration can be turned off without uninstalling anything. The file is at $(b)config/ultimatearmoury-common.toml$().

Under $(b)[integraciones]$() there is one option per mod. Setting it to $(b)false$() removes its items and recipes entirely, as if the mod were not there.$(br2)The AllTheModium one needs the Ex Deorum one to be active as well.
